::: {.unit unit="lp-bred-small-biter"}
Most of a young culture's waves. Its clinic soon moves it on to bigger breeds.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-bred-medium-biter"}
The breed a culture without its clinic falls back to, with the small biter.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-bred-spore"}
The one breed that looks up. It travels with waves sent at a base that defends itself with drones and robots.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-bred-medium-spitter"}
It stays back from the wall and spits over it while the biters break through.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-bred-cinder"}
Bred for walls that have held. It runs to the wall and bursts there, and a well-aimed group takes the corner turrets with it.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-bred-big-biter"}
Most of any grown wave. A big biter costs the culture little biomass, so it spends them freely.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-bred-stomper"}
A bred pentapod. It steps over walls and shrugs off bullets.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-bred-behemoth-biter"}
The culture breeds few of them and sends them where the wall is thickest.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-bred-big-burster"}
Sent one rank at a time at the turrets covering a wave's way in. Killed short of them, only its core goes off.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-sweeper"}
Bred when a wave's way in crosses your mines. It walks into the minefield and bursts there.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-bred-scout"}
When you see one circling your wall, a wave is on its way.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-bred-carrier"}
It carries a new culture to a wild spawner field farther out. Kill it on the way and the culture never starts.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-technician"}
Without technicians the biochambers stop, and without biochambers the incubators stop breeding.
:::
